caveats: Matched requests have fixed input but different realized system trajectories; no independent repeat or causal treatment estimate.
Tier, replica and largest-stage groups are endogenous conditional diagnostics, not common controlled populations.
Stage spans include queue/IPC/scheduling and overlapping background work, not function CPU time or GPU kernel time.
Control histograms count samples, not time; held-GPU durations integrate actual physical union intervals.
No stage is subtracted from TTFT and no unknown numerical correctness is imputed.
Transfer population is not the residual request population: background prefetch and coalesced waiters may differ.
Server and client clocks are never subtracted or added. Remote spans overlap client stages.
Client receive interval includes local reservation/write; it is not pure wire time.
Before-loading remainder includes workspace preparation and timing-call boundaries; not attributed to a function.
Request TTFT is unchanged; these are diagnostic measured spans, not counterfactual saved latency.
